best_idea: Advance the tick clock by one fixed step per tick, not to the current time, and cap ticks per loop call; when far behind with nobody else connected, drop the backlog instead of bursting.
decision_why: Keep the due-time clock, the per-call cap, the bounded catch-up and the render fraction; reject the stop-the-world wait and the end-of-game on silence, because one slow fighter must not freeze a fight with up to MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 and a silent fighter should be marked absent through the ledger.
acceptance: Server test: with 24 ticks of backlog (1.2 s at 50 ms) and a second fighter connected, one call runs exactly three ticks and the rest drain over later calls; with the other fighter gone, the next call runs exactly one tick and the backlog is not replayed.
